verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device SDK with a hosted, OpenAI-compatible cloud API, so webhook event subscriptions are a fair question for it. The evidence only shows in-process event streams (generateStream token events, DownloadEvent streams), not registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. In-process event streams are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
